pose: The Mamenchisaurus has its incredibly long neck draped across the foreground like a heavy cable, with its head resting on a patch of soft moss. One front leg is folded slightly to lower its body height. It is using its snout to nudge a pile of fallen ginkgo leaves, looking for a lost tooth. Its expression is one of 'patient exhaustion'—eyes drooping slightly, a soft furrow in its brow, and its mouth held open just enough to reveal the long, spatula-like teeth. It looks up at the player with a slow, heavy blink, its long neck disappearing into the blurred green background of the forest.

visual_logic.substrate: Thick moss over dark, damp river silt

behavioral_intent: Weary but cooperative search. The extreme length of the neck leading to the small, pained face creates a strong visual 'trail' for the player to follow to the puzzle area.
